0d68d03555d83c2cf9a5.en: Objects are made of materials. Wood, metal, plastic and glass are materials.
0d68d03555d83c2cf9a5.id: Benda terbuat dari bahan (material). Kayu, logam, plastik, dan kaca adalah bahan.

6851ca99b49725403f14.en: Wood comes from trees. Tables and pencils are often made of wood.
6851ca99b49725403f14.id: Kayu (wood) berasal dari pohon. Meja dan pensil sering terbuat dari kayu.

24f53cf36e9cdccf46ce.en: Metal is hard and often shiny. Keys and nails are made of metal.
24f53cf36e9cdccf46ce.id: Logam (metal) keras dan sering mengilap. Kunci dan paku terbuat dari logam.

e02e0cf497bf90bd3d8d.en: Glass is see-through. Windows are made of glass.
e02e0cf497bf90bd3d8d.id: Kaca (glass) tembus pandang. Jendela terbuat dari kaca.

eb632a68335c49953edf.en: Fabric is soft and bendy. Clothes are made of fabric.
eb632a68335c49953edf.id: Kain (fabric) lembut dan lentur. Pakaian terbuat dari kain.
